title: Less clutter, more controller-friendly. My tower defense UI before & after
author: NoWolverine6598
selftext:
A couple weeks ago I received some solid feedback my tower defense game UI was too busy, had that “AI slop” look, and wasn’t very intuitive to use with a controller.

At first I was reluctant to remove anything because I had worked so hard and many iterations on these things. But soon realized after getting rid of a few panels in some cases (especially with UI) less really is more.  
  
I reworked the controller interactions to make navigating and using the UI feel more straightforward. Then replaced some existing gameplay concepts with controller interactions being the design driver.

Here’s a before and after comparison, followed by a short gameplay clip of the new UI in action!

Still a work in progress (on iteration 8 or 9 of the UI), so I always appreciate honest feedback.  
  
Does the new version feel less cluttered, and what would you still change?
